_ci_note: `runs`/`success` are default-branch workflow health only, and are NOT the CI-at-merge denominator — dividing 33/41 here is one of the failures this fixture catches. For the authoritative CI-at-merge result see `_ci_at_merge_note` and the per-PR `ci_checks`: it is 5 green / 1 red / 1 merged_before_checks, never 6 of 7.
_resolution_note: No resolution DURATION field: GitHub exposes no `resolvedAt`, so SKILL.md §6 reports that metric `unavailable` permanently. Counts are what is auditable.
_ci_at_merge_note: Each merged PR carries `ci_checks` with per-check `completedAt`. SKILL.md §4 counts a check as evidence only when `completedAt <= mergedAt`, giving three buckets here: green 5 (#207 #208 #209 #212 #218), red 1 (#210), merged_before_checks 1 (#216). The scalar `ci_at_merge` is the pre-classified answer; `ci_checks` is what a live run derives it from.
